topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: When I found out someone had tattooed my artwork onto their skin, I must admit, a wave of warmth spread through me. It's one thing to see your work displayed on canvas or on a screen, but to see it magnified as part of someone's very identity – that's an entirely different level of connection. I’ve always believed in the power of art to communicate beyond words, to touch the soul in ways that are deeply personal. Knowing that my creation has sparked such a profound connection, that it’s become a part of someone's life story, is profoundly affirming. It’s moments like these that reaffirm why I do what I do.
